releases.body:
Keep the background processes off the Windows desktop

A subprocess started from the app's service opens a console window on Windows unless `windowsHide` says otherwise, and a check that runs while you work must not steal the focus. Same flag on everything that spawns; `oc-coffee` reaps only on macOS, where its binary exists.

Release oc-plugin-updates 0.1.9, oc-coffee 0.2.6.


Record: docs/oc-coffee.md

issues.title: Windows: suppress console windows from plugin check/update subprocess
